RISK FACTORS FOR DECUBITUS (PRESSURE) ULCERS
- Age (higher risk the older the patient)
- Male gender
- History of cerebrovascular accident (5-fold increase in risk)
- Diabetes mellitus
- Feeding difficulties
- Decreased serum albumin (3-fold increase in risk)
- Emergency admission (up to 36-fold increase in risk in patients admitted for surgical indications)
- Faecal incontinence (up to 3-fold increase in risk)
- Fractures (up to 5-fold increase in risk)
- Number of days in bed and Number of days without nutrition
In older persons with functional limitations (bed- or chair-bound):
- Decreased body weight (2-fold increase in risk) and Dry skin
- Immobility or reduced mobility
- Lymphopaenia (5-fold increase in risk)

Facility dependent factors
- Ambulation difficulties
